title: Ie uoi douleur / Fauuel nous a / Fauvel autant (anonymous, Roman de Fauvel)
desc: Anonymous, Ie uoi douleur / Fauuel nous a / Fauvel autant. 3 voices (Triplum, Motetus, Tenor), each on its own staff.
